content:
maria_sales: FYI — OrbisCare asked if we can onboard TritonX (tritonx-13b-q4f) into their POC. They care about latency (150ms p90), cost, and a checkbox on not storing logs. Copied SE/SEC/FIN.

ajay_se: Quick note — model shape ~13B, q4f quant looks fine for accuracy. Big caveat: kv-cache with >6k context pushes GPU memory; for 1000 RPS we need 2x baseline GPU pool or a dedicated shard layout.

sam_fin: Ballpark pricing for Dedicated run (1000 RPS, 8k context): ~$12k/mo if we use reserved 2x pool. If they accept 4k context we can drop to ~$7k/mo. I can surface a formal quote. :money_with_wings:

tanya_sec: Security constraints: Orbis wants no request bodies logged and customer-managed KMS. We need to confirm Private deployment + KMS integration and a data-retention config. Also they'll want a filled security questionnaire (SOC2 snippets, env isolation).

ben_sre: Latency SLO: p90 150ms is tough at 8k context on q4f unless we shard aggressively + enable KV prefix caching. Suggest fallback to tritonx-6b-fast for tails.

ajay_se: I'll run a quick compat test this afternoon. Plan: run kv-cache stress at 500/1000 RPS, report memory and p90. Quick config snippet I'm starting with:

```yaml
model: tritonx-13b-q4f
quant: q4f
kv_cache: enabled
max_context_tokens: 8192
batching: dynamic
alloc_policy: dedicated_shard
```

ajay_se: If cache pressure is high, we can try chunked-KV (reduce resident key size) or fall back to 6B for interactive endpoints.

sam_fin: Action for quote: two lines — (1) Dedicated 2x pool, 8k context, $12k/mo; (2) Dedicated 1x pool, 4k context, $7k/mo. Also add optional canary fallback to 6b at +10% infra overhead.

maria_sales: Nice. Tanya — can you start the security questionnaire answers for Private + KMS? Ben — can you scope required SLO changes and a fallback routing policy? Ajay/Sam — share test results and a draft quote by EOD. Orbis wants a decision mid-week. :calendar:

deploy-bot: catalog-scan completed — tritonx-13b-q4f flagged: "missing_cve_metadata" (low). See /infra/tools/catalog for remediation.

maria_sales: Thanks team — keeping Orbis in the loop. Will set a short sync tomorrow 10:30am PT.
